dgps.note: Control DGP: idio ~ N(0, 0.003), matching the P40 primary family so the Gaussian control reproduces P40-family behaviour.
Student-t(4) idio with scale matched to GAUSSIAN variance (scale = idio_vol / sqrt(2)); fat tails / excess kurtosis.
Two-state Markov volatility: calm 0.5x base vol, stress 2.0x base vol, state persistence 0.95; vol clustering / non-stationarity.
Merton jump-diffusion idio: jump intensity 0.05/day, jump mean -0.5 sigma, jump sd 1.5 sigma; discontinuity / gap risk.
Log-normal stochastic vol (vol-of-vol 0.4, mean-reversion 0.1); persistent heteroskedasticity.

provenance.note: Deterministic synthetic estimator bakeoff across five data-generating processes (GAUSSIAN_IID control, STUDENT_T, REGIME_SWITCH, JUMP_DIFFUSION, STOCHASTIC_VOL). Asset returns = beta * BTC_return + idio, betas linspace(0.2, 2.4, 40), BTC prices from tests/fixtures/wide_bab_universe.csv. Not real market data; not market profitability evidence. Cell = (DGP, seed, estimator): 5 DGPs x 8 seeds x 4 estimators = 160 cells. Compares shipped rolling-OLS (window=90) vs P35 runner-ups (EWMA halflife=40; Shrinkage intensity=0.3, target=1.0 and cross_sectional_mean) and reports which estimator (if any) is least-broken by non-Gaussianity. Deflated significance over n_trials_total read-only from P38 WP1.

estimator_comparison.least_broken_reason: Highest mean deflated Sharpe across non-Gaussian DGPs (STUDENT_T, REGIME_SWITCH, JUMP_DIFFUSION, STOCHASTIC_VOL) among estimators passing all neutrality invariants; honest ranking, not tuned to a positive.
estimator_comparison.note: The least-broken estimator is ranked on deflated Sharpe over non-Gaussian DGPs only. A null/negative ranking is a valid finding; nothing is tuned to chase a positive and the shipped default is retained regardless of outcome.
